articles.title: Ether jumps 18% to $2,250 as bitcoin tops $69,000 in broad crypto rally
articles.snippet: Every major except tron posted double-digit weekly gains, with nearly $1.4 billion of short positions wiped out after the Treasury doubled its bond buybacks.

articles.title: Bitcoin surges above $68,000, liquidating $1.4 billion shorts as Treasury buybacks boost risk appetite
articles.snippet: BTC rose about 6% while ether, solana and crypto stocks climbed after the Treasury doubled the size of its bond buybacks.

articles.title: Bitcoin miners pour billions into AI as capex outpaces revenue 15-to-1
articles.snippet: Nine public miners generated $341 million from AI and HPC operations in the first half of 2026 after spending more than $5 billion on capital assets.

articles.title: Most Americans say the Trump family’s crypto investments are not ‘appropriate’: Poll
articles.snippet: A new poll showed 63% of 1,166 Americans varied sharply along partisan lines, with a majority of Republicans saying it was appropriate for Trump and his family to invest in crypto.

articles.title: Rushed CLARITY Act vote could set legislation back, Gallego warns
articles.snippet: Senator Ruben Gallego said the White House has not provided point-by-point feedback on a bipartisan ethics proposal as a September vote approaches.
